Viewing Saturday 3rd October @ 11:10am - 11:20am. Call/text Siobhan on 087 2737812 to view.

Lynam Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market this stunning Sorohan built apartment. Boasting a large balcony and high ceilings, No.60 will have instant appeal and is extremely bright and airy.  

No. 60 is built to a very high specification and in excellent order throughout with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a large open plan kitchen/dining and living room, ample storage.  All floors can be accessed by both lift and stairs through a high spec lobby.

The location is second to none for convenience with the LUAS within walking distance.  Easy access to the N11, M50, and City Centre.  Goatstown, Sandyford, Ranelagh, Milltown, Stillorgan and Blackrock are also all within easy driving distance. Some of Dublin’s finest schools including St Kilian’s, Mount Anville and Our Lady’s Grove are all within easy reach.  UCD/Smurfit business school are also within an easy distance.

Wooden flooring with access to a large Hot press and separate large storage cupboard. Intercom.

Family Bathroom:
Generously proportioned bathroom contains a bath with overhead shower, wc, wash hand basin.  Tiled floor and part-tiled walls. Large Vanity.

Master Bedroom:
Well-proportioned master bedroom with fitted wardrobes overlooking the front of the
Property.  Double glazed door to spacious balcony.

En-suite:
The en-suite for the master bedroom has a tiled floor and part-tiled walls.
corner shower unit, wc., wash-hand basin & vanity mirror.

Bedroom 2:
Double bedroom. Built-in
Wardrobes. Wooden flooring.

Kitchen/Dining

Kitchen:
Very smart high spec fitted kitchen with wall & floor units, with
stainless steel roller door counter unit and granite worktop.  Integrated Fridge/Freezer and Washing
Machine.  Oven, Gas Hob, Cooker Hood. Dishwasher. Very generous size dining area alongside kitchen.

Sitting Room:
Extremely large spacious sitting room with floor to ceiling window which gives bright
and airy feel to the room. Double Glazed door leading to large balcony for afternoon coffees.
